whatsappMessage:
Hi Gums & Teeth Dental Clinic team,

I noticed your dental clinic has a stellar 5.0★ rating with 21 reviews in Kankarbagh, Patna, but you currently lack a dedicated mobile website for online appointment bookings.

Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp consultation booking, painless dental procedure highlights, aur clinic timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/gumsteeth

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Gums & Teeth Dental Clinic team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with a direct WhatsApp appointment booking button and a showcase of your 5.0★ patient care in Kankarbagh, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
